A man walks past The Earthshot Prize branding at a press conference ahead of the Earthshot Prize awards night in Mumba on November 12, 2026. | Photo Credit: Reuters
Next week, Mumbai will become the stage for one of the world’s boldest climate ideas. The largest ever Earthshot Prize edition will bring together innovators, investors, businesses, policymakers and young people to turn environmental solutions into impact at scale. Five winners will each receive £1 million to accelerate their work.
It all began with a simple but powerful idea: that human ingenuity, innovation and optimism can help repair our planet. Founded by His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales, The Earthshot Prize seeks solutions capable of delivering transformative environmental impact. Since the Prize was launched in 2020, India has produced more Earthshot finalists and winners than any other country (nine finalists including four winners). This year two of the 15 finalists are based in India. As the Prize arrives in Mumbai, India’s growing influence in clean growth and climate innovation will be on full display.
